definition_en: to express sadness or dissatisfaction about something, often again and again
core_image: 深夜坐在窗边、对着旧照片一声接一声地叹气
scene: 老人抚摸着泛黄的合影，一遍遍叹气。The old man bemoaned the loss of the quiet village of his childhood.
sceneCN: 这里 bemoaned 是「哀叹、惋惜」（第 1 个义项：为失去的事悲伤叹息）；句意是老人一再叹息，怀念童年那个宁静的村庄。

derivatives.zh: 基础词，义为「呻吟；抱怨声」
由 moan 加后缀构成，义为「呻吟般的；悲哀的」

senses.title: To express sorrow for a loss
senses.definition: to show deep sadness about something lost or gone
senses.definitionCN: 为失去或逝去的事物表达深深的悲伤
senses.example: The old man bemoaned the loss of the quiet village of his childhood.
senses.exampleCN: 老人哀叹童年那个宁静村庄的消逝。
senses.why: Be- strengthens moan, so bemoan is to moan over something.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 be- 强化 moan（呻吟），bemoan 即「为某事连连呻吟叹息」。

senses.title: To complain about a situation
senses.definition: to say repeatedly that a situation is bad or unsatisfactory
senses.definitionCN: 反复诉说某种情形如何糟糕、不如意
senses.example: Columnists bemoan the decline of thoughtful reading.
senses.exampleCN: 专栏作者们哀叹深度阅读的衰落。
senses.why: Sorrowful moaning slides into habitual complaint.
senses.whyCN: 悲叹的呻吟滑向习惯性的抱怨。

intro.en: Bemoan is the prefix be- plus moan, to moan over something.
intro.cn: bemoan 由前缀 be- 加 moan 构成，意为「为某事呻吟叹息」。

items.en: mænan meant to complain, to mourn.
items.cn: 古英语 mænan 意为「抱怨、哀悼」。

items.en: menen and mone carried the senses of mourning and groaning.
items.cn: 中古英语 menen、mone 兼有哀悼与呻吟之义。

items.en: the compound bemoan appeared in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 复合词 bemoan 出现于十六世纪。

items.en: it was used for mourning the dead and lamenting misfortune.
items.cn: 十七、十八世纪用于哀悼逝者、悲叹不幸。

items.en: it now often means grumbling about public decline.
items.cn: 如今常指对公共事务衰落的感叹抱怨。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the be- prefix or moan root; the near-meaning group gathers words for sorrowful complaint.
note.cn: 形近组共享 be- 前缀或 moan 词基；近义组汇集悲叹抱怨类词。

entries.definition: a low sound of pain or complaint
entries.definitionCN: 呻吟；抱怨声——bemoan 的词基
拆除——拼写相近，词源不同
悲叹——同用 be- 前缀的近义构词

entries.definition: to express deep grief or regret
to feel sorrow for a death or loss

entries.definitionCN: 抱怨；不带诗意的日常说法

normalIntro.en: Bemoan is be- plus moan: moan over something.
normalIntro.cn: bemoan 是 be- 加 moan：为某事叹息不止。

normal.cn: 过去式与过去分词是 bemoaned。

normal.en: Bemoan one's fate means to keep sighing about it.
normal.cn: bemoan one's fate 指连连哀叹命运。

normal.en: It is stronger than plain complain.
normal.cn: 语气比单纯的 complain 更悲。

abstract.en: See sighs fogging an old photograph.
abstract.cn: 看叹息在旧照片上凝成雾气。

abstract.en: Feel the ache of empty chairs.
Picture a bell tolling slowly at dusk.
abstract.cn: 想象黄昏里缓缓的钟声。

examples.en: The old man bemoaned the loss of the quiet village of his childhood.
examples.cn: 老人哀叹童年那个宁静村庄的消逝。

examples.en: Columnists bemoan the decline of thoughtful reading.
examples.cn: 专栏作者们哀叹深度阅读的衰落。

examples.en: She bemoaned her fate to anyone who would listen.
examples.cn: 她逢人便哀叹自己的命运。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「比·梦」——总拿如今和从前的美梦比，越比越叹气。

root: 前缀 be-（古英语，表「对……施加」）加 moan（古英语 mænan「抱怨、哀悼」，与 mourn 同源）；复合词 bemoan 十六世纪见于英语，本义「为……呻吟哀悼」，后引申「一再抱怨、惋惜」。

sensesIntro.en: One verb turns the sound of grief into habitual complaint.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个动词，把悲伤的叹息声变成习以为常的抱怨。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: sighs fogging an old photograph at a dark window.
core.cn: 核心意象：暗窗边对着旧照片一声声叹气。

intro.en: Bemoan shows be- pressing the verb moan onto an object.
intro.cn: bemoan 展示 be- 把动词 moan 压到对象上。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the parts are Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，组成部分源自古英语。

items.meaning: a sound of grief or pain
a deep sound of pain or protest

latinEntries.meaning: to wail, mourn; source of lament
